description: Minimum backtest length, in years, before the best of N independent trials is not expected to reach a target Sharpe by luck, and with backtest_years, the most independent trials those years allow. Send effective_independent_trials, backtest_years, or both. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

backtest_years.description: Length of the backtest in years, to get the most independent trials it allows.

effective_independent_trials.description: Independent trials (backtests, parameter sets, ideas) tried; gives the minimum backtest length.

target_sharpe_annualized.description: In-sample annualized Sharpe you would take as a discovery; default 1.

name: validate_backtest_length
title: Minimum backtest length
